messages:
incidents-bot: [ALERT] spike detected: 5xx/errors rise from 0.5% -> 7.8% across api-gateway -> runtime (18:41 UTC). paging oncall @robin_oncall :rotating_light:
robin_oncall: got the page, jumping in. any quick blamesticks?
maria_sre: seeing lots of 502/504s proxied from runtime shards. graphs: cpu steady, but prefix-kv latencies and eviction rate up ~x10.
devin_runtime: logs show rapid writeback churn to KV prefetch layer, a bunch of "writeback-failed: checksum mismatch" lines. possible corruption/rollback loop. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T18:40:12Z runtime-54 writeback.go:312 error "writeback-failed" key=prefix_0x9a3 attempt=3 checksum=0xdeadbeef
2026-03-15T18:40:12Z runtime-54 cache.go:89 evict prefix_0x9a3 reason=writeback_storm
```
kai_support: customer reports: "tokenization errors and 502s" from production app, started ~18:41 UTC, multiple regions affected. Ticket #INC-9821 created.
jamie_prod: triage: impact is user-facing API calls failing (~8% of requests), some timed out at gateway layer. We're getting alerts from Synthetics as well.
robin_oncall: first mitigation: disable aggressive prefetch in runtime fleet for the affected pool, and flip prefix-writeback to async-fallback mode. applying now.
ops-bot: command executed: `runtime-config set --pool=prod-prefix --prefetch.window=disabled`
ops-bot: command executed: `runtime-config set --pool=prod-prefix --writeback.mode=async-fallback`
maria_sre: early signal: 5xx rate dropping to ~3.2% within 90s. evictions still high but tail latency improving.
devin_runtime: adding temporary circuit-breaker on writeback path to avoid retry storms. patch deployed to 3/4 hosts in pool.
eve_customer: (from support DM) customer: "we see huge 502 surge, premium users impacted, they're asking for ETA."
kai_support: replied with: "we're mitigating, will update in 15m, root cause suspected cache writeback loop."
jamie_prod: notifying account execs and putting a banner on status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/3740011223
robin_oncall: rolling window: we're also routing a small percent of traffic (5%) to fallback model variant that uses read-through-only cache to avoid writeback. kicking rollout.
ops-bot: rollout: `router set-weight --route=/v1/generate --variant=fallback-readonly --weight=5%`
maria_sre: metric note: backend error-type split shows a spike of "kv-checksum-failure" traces at 18:40-18:44, correlates with prefetch daemon churn.
devin_runtime: live debug confirms one host had corrupted prefetch index leading to immediate evictions when writeback retried. starting targeted pod-restart for that host.
robin_oncall: targeted restart done (runtime-54). monitoring.
maria_sre: after restart + config flips, 5xx down to 0.9% and gateway timeouts dropping. customer impact window ~6m from page to stable.
jamie_prod: drafting post-incident note for affected customers. collecting request IDs samples for support.
kai_support: gathering customer request-ids: `req_20260315_18{41->48}_*` and attaching to ticket.
devin_runtime: next steps: run consistency scan on prefix indexes across pool to detect any lingering corrupt entries, and add a fast-rollback for writeback to bypass corrupted keys.
maria_sre: creating follow-up runbook item: add a health-check that flags checksum anomalies and auto-quenches writeback for that prefix.
robin_oncall: handoff to night SRE at 19:22 UTC. @maria_sre please own follow-up and RCA. I'll update oncall log.
maria_sre: acknowledged, will start RCA and coordinate customer comms.
jamie_prod: timeline: 18:40 alert -> 18:42 mitigation flips -> 18:44 targeted restart -> 18:46 errors back to baseline. prep external summary.
eve_customer: thanks, can ops confirm if any data loss?
devin_runtime: no persistent data loss observed; there were failed writebacks but we fell back to read-through semantics for affected keys, and we added checksum validation.
robin_oncall: final: full incident unpaged to incident channel, handover note added to #incidents-archive, and paging suppressed. if anything regresses ping @robin_oncall. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: incident closed for oncall shift.
notes: live debugging thread: prefetched KV writeback checksum failures caused eviction storms and upstream 5xx/timeouts. mitigations: disable prefetch, flip writeback to async-fallback, targeted host restart, route % traffic to readonly fallback, add circuit-breaker. handoff to SRE for RCA and runbook updates. customer comms and status page updated.
